name: Trade Report 22 Choice
definition: Provides details on the reported trade transactions.

New.name: New
New.definition: Indicates whether transaction is reported for the first time.

Modification.name: Modification
Modification.definition: Indicates a modification to the terms or details of a previously reported position or correction the erroneous data fields of a previously submitted position.

Error.name: Error
Error.definition: Indicates whether transaction was reported by mistake and needs to be removed.

EarlyTermination.name: Early Termination
EarlyTermination.definition: Indicates that reported position is a termination of an existing contract.

PositionComponent.name: Position Component
PositionComponent.definition: Indicates contract that is to be reported as a new trade and also included in a separate position report on the same day.

CollateralUpdate.name: Collateral Update
CollateralUpdate.definition: Details of the loan used for financing the transaction.

Correction.name: Correction
Correction.definition: Indicates a modification to the terms or details of a previously reported position or correction the erroneous data fields of a previously submitted position.

ValuationUpdate.name: Valuation Update
ValuationUpdate.definition: Indicates an update to the valuations of a previously reported position, but not a correction.
